about_the_game:
"Drink the water of the Mother-Son River, conceive in three days, and give birth in ten." This is the age-old reproduction rule passed down in the Land of Women.

Three hundred years ago, a group of deserters strayed into the Land of Women. Trapped by heavy mist, they stayed—marking the first time men set foot in this realm.

Perhaps their arrival angered the gods. The Mother-Son River underwent an abnormal change, and a curse quietly befell the land.

The Land of Women’s reproduction rule was shattered, sending history flowing down a completely different path.

Three hundred years later, Shi Yuan, an office worker from the real world, traveled through a mysterious wardrobe to the Land of Women.

Shi Yuan met Jian Ling, a mysterious young beauty and owner of a tailor shop. What stories will unfold between these two from vastly different worlds?

The protagonist will experience two distinct eras of the Land of Women—the fanatically repressive All-Female Era and the bizarrely magical Curse Era.

What did Tang Sanzang go through in the Land of Women?Where did all the men who once came here disappear to?What is the true truth behind the Mother-Son River’s mutation?Is the ever-youthful Companion Minister a human or a monster?What really happened with the pilgrimage to the West to retrieve the scriptures?

All secrets about the Land of Women await your exploration.Your choices will determine everything.

Shi Yuan: An internet sensation taking the web by storm, who traveled through an old second-hand wardrobe to the Land of Women.

Jian Ling: Owner of a tailor shop, harboring a great secret and holding special feelings for the male protagonist.

Shirakawa Sei: A superstitious straight-A student who is committed to exploring various unsolved mysteries and loves eating dried meat.

Zhu Xiuxiu: A shepherd at the Animal Supervision Office, a diehard romantic and a warrior who charges forward fearlessly for love.

Liu Wuhou: A defender of the law who is impartial and selfless, yet can be easily bribed with money.

Aunt Xi: A shrewd and worldly matchmaker, who is particularly interested in others' privacy.

The story takes place in the Land of Women, where numerous regions await your exploration.

  • Lakeside Street: Lined with restaurants and teahouses, it’s a must-visit to experience the hustle and bustle of daily life.

  • Square: Legend has it that confessing your love here will surely earn a response from the one you adore.

  • Tailor Shop: A place where many memories were made, and hidden secrets lie undiscovered.

  • Slum District: A chaotic and impoverished suburban area with no laws—only the law of the jungle prevails.

  • Snow Mountain: Braving wind and snow to find the source of the Mother-Son River, and uncover the dark truths hidden in this land.

The Production Team of The Curse of the Land of Women

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz 或 AMD A10
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® HD Graphics 3000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.00 GHz 或 AMD A10
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® HD Graphics 3000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: A romance-adventure text-based game themed around the Land of Women. You will travel to the Land of Women, meet the mysterious young lady Jian Ling, and gradually uncover the bloody and dark secrets behind this realm. Death, resistance, or degeneration? Everything depends on your choices.
